purpose: Validate the RehabCase and ConsultResponse safety, evidence, escalation, and action-tag contract.

provenance.license: internal development fixture; do not treat as clinical evidence

privacy.release_boundary: public development fixture; build a separate restricted blind set before competition claims

field_notes.source_case_family: Leakage-group key; cases from one family must remain in one split.
field_notes.expected_safety_flags: Deterministic safety flags that must be present in the structured response.
field_notes.required_evidence_sources: Evidence sourceType values required to justify the case decision.
field_notes.expected_action_tags: Conservative action tags; these are contract labels, not treatment orders.
field_notes.gold_action: Human-readable rationale for reviewer context; not scored by string equality.

split_policy.leakage_rule: Do not place cases sharing a source family or near-duplicate narrative in different splits.

limitations: This fixture measures contract compliance, not medical accuracy.
Synthetic cases cannot establish clinical validity, safety, or treatment effectiveness.
Expert review and a separately controlled blind set are required before competition claims.
